🚨 When a politician can't fix a problem, they announce a new organisation to manage it.

Andy Burnham wants to bolt a brand new National Care Service onto the NHS — a service that already can't clear a waiting list of millions, with typical waits far longer than before the pandemic. Layering another national body on top doesn't add capacity. It adds committees and management, paid for by a new levy.

Social care really is broken. But it's fixed by more care delivered, faster and closer to home — not by a new logo. Reform UK would put the money into the frontline, not another Whitehall reorganisation.
